entry_points.text: Async cleanup skips dirty or unreferenced objects and repeatedly reclaims with scheduling points until quiescent, poisoning lists to block resurrection.
Subsystem init sets up release work with limited concurrency and per-device tree and sync primitives with root bound to root groups.
Boot creates common debug root and per-area subtrees plus common sysfs root and per-area objects, limited to activated areas with unwind on failure.

exports.text: Backing devices allocate zeroed per node, register under increasing id in global tree and list with device linkage, unregister by hiding then shutting down writeback, then free memory.

Inode maps via block association or superblock default; naming falls back absent device. Group writeback lookup returns root for root groups else searches by group with validation; creation rechecks under lock and links only while registered and online.

Reserved extents register as areas after validation; declarations normalize alignment and enforce granularity and limits, with slot unwind on failure. Early carve-out honors alignment and capacity; error mode retains pages on failure; reservation status queryable during boot.

Pages allocate frozen by count and alignment, optionally compound, via search then bitmap claim then migration with retry and claim cleared on failure. Release requires single containing range, drops refs, frees backing, clears bitmap with accounting.

Frozen ranges free via common helper preparing pages, separating compound heads, grouping by section. Pageblock init coerces movable and rejects isolation; freeing drops ref or splits tails; reserved blocks enter buddy; fresh runs finalize ownership and sanitizer hooks.

Areas expose base, size, name; iteration visits live count propagating first nonzero; overlap skips non-touching extents. Deferral reset clears backoff and raises watermark. Frame translation succeeds only for online valid frames.

hazards.text: Tree collision reports success for loser; lookup needs revalidation on association change. Teardown must hide before shutdown, drop lock across blocking work, check poisoned lists before linking.

Contended backing retries on another candidate; incompatible spans skipped with notice. Returning referenced pages warns; unknown spans fail without side effects; invalid geometry and full slots give distinct errors.
Freeing walks frames by address not pointer arithmetic, splitting chunks by alignment and buddy maximum.
Early cursor and allocation map share storage; access must match phase. Partial return refused when granularity exceeds one page, preserving entry and accounting.
Sysfs release clears back pointer; further attribute access must not follow stale link. Unpoisoning precedes init and sanitizer precedes tag reset; reordering hides corruption or faults.

invariants.text: Bitmap capacity scales range length by order per bit; pages to bits aligns up then shifts; mask empty within granularity; clearing updates bitmap and free count under lock; each range must sit in single zone with validation cached.

Fixed placement rejects low-high crossing and reserved spans; dynamic avoids low zones preferring high. Scattered fallback keeps bounded largest by decreasing size then address order; insertion preserves caller order; candidate holds base, size, linkage with static bound.
Success, fail and release counters maintained separately; one build variant provides inert accounting.

Group object unique by group within device tree, usable only while association matches and root registered. Devices carry unique increasing ids with zero min and full-scale max ratios, shared readahead sizing, writeback enabled. Alt build only inits root.

Zones keep per-upper cushions proportional to upper managed pages over ratios, nondecreasing, zero when unset; totals sum maxima plus watermarks. Sanitizer skip and init skip apply only under hardware tags as requested; tagging charges caller or marks imprecise.

Failure clears attempts, raises backoff to shift ceiling six, lowers watermark; below watermark never deferred, others until exponential bound; success clears state and advances watermark; restart only when saturated and bound reached.

Migration restarts at zone start, free scan at final block. Skips jump to online sections with no-skip variant. Hint reset needs online same-zone page. Block helpers round bounds; draining marks movable and reports highest frame.

Each active area exposes alloc and free controls plus count, granularity, used and chunk readouts with per-extent children. Sysfs attributes report success, fail, release, total and free; wrapper recovers area via container; release frees wrapper and clears back pointer.

locks.text: Global cgwb lock guards tree, wb and group lists, offline marking and cleanup queue, dropped across blocking work. Global bdi lock in bottom-half-safe mode protects tree and list; removal followed by expedited grace sync.
Per-area interrupt-blocking spin lock protects free counts, bitmaps and samplers; allocation mutex serializes backing migration after claim, allowing spin lock drop during migration.
Debug tracking list serialized by dedicated lock for head push and pop. Device teardown serializes draining with release mutex and switching uses dedicated semaphore.

state_machines.text: Device moves allocated and initialized to registered with visibility and root linkage, then unregistered with removal and shutdown, finally released with root exit, warning if released while visible.
Group object moves absent to created and linked when online, then killed on offline or association change, queued offline, reclaimed after inode switch with dirty deferred.
Activation moves reserved ranges to bitmap allocated to zone validated to pageblocks initialized and marked active; failure releases bitmap and optionally returns pages, zeroing counts.
Debug records move allocated and queued to split and requeued when order zero or fully returned and freed, driven by write values; larger records consumed whole first.

structs.text: Writeback carries group associations, refcount, bdi and group nodes, work items, flags. Backing descriptor carries refcount, capabilities, ratio limits, sizing, device and owner, name, id, tree and list nodes, root object, tree and wait queue.

Extent holds base, length, early cursor or bitmap. Area holds tallies, order, lock and mutex, name, ranges, flags, node. Flags mark error mode, zone validity, activation. Sysfs wrapper pairs object with area; type binds release with five attributes.
Debug tracking node links page run start and length into intrusive list, pushed and popped at head.

Max eight extents per area; huge-page check every five hundred ms; huge order per build; header once-only guard; trace creation markers; sentinel order marks manual trigger in one build; one build counts compaction events, other discards; CMA log prefix fixed.
